title: Testing your node without a GPU
hook: Your node's bugs mostly don't need a card to show up. Three levels of test, from calling the function to running the real engine in one process.

verified.claim: A V3 execute can be called directly with no engine, and returns NodeOutput. cls.hidden is None there.
verified.ref: direct call of a test node's classmethod

verified.claim: GET_SCHEMA raises ValueError for duplicate ids, and Exception for a missing execute.
The in-process harness here loads core nodes in about 8 seconds and runs a graph with no GPU or server.
verified.ref: our test machine, one run; scripts/verify_university_graphs.py uses the same approach

verified.claim: Failures from running: a bare int return gives TypeError, a bare tensor return loses its batch axis with no error, wrong argument name gives TypeError, too few outputs gives IndexError.
ComfyUI's own suite has testing nodes and execution tests.

unchecked: The harness calls internal functions, such as validate_prompt and PromptExecutor, which may change between versions. It worked on v0.43.0.
One timing on our test machine. Yours may differ.
We didn't run ComfyUI's own test suite for this lesson. We read it.
